svg.title: PromptVault step-by-step user flow from listing to prompt use
svg.desc: Sequence of actions: creator generates AES key, encrypts prompt, lists on-chain. Buyer pays, gets FHE.allow, decrypts key via TN, decrypts prompt from IPFS, uses it to call an LLM.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does a creator generate an AES key for PromptVault?')
sendPrompt('How does a creator AES-encrypt their prompt and upload to IPFS?')
sendPrompt('How does cofhejs encrypt the AES key for PromptVault?')
sendPrompt('What does listPrompt do in the PromptVault contract?')
sendPrompt('What ACL grants happen in listPrompt?')
sendPrompt('How does a buyer browse and buy a prompt on PromptVault?')
sendPrompt('What does FHE.allow do for the buyer in PromptVault?')
sendPrompt('How does the buyer call decryptForView with a permit?')
sendPrompt('How does the buyer rebuild the AES key from two parts?')
sendPrompt('How does the buyer fetch and decrypt the prompt from IPFS?')
sendPrompt('How does a buyer use a PromptVault prompt with an LLM?')
g.text: F. Call LLM with system prompt

svg.text: 🔒 AES key appears only in step D (browser RAM)
Prompt plaintext appears only in step E–F (browser RAM)
